### HW Problem 2

load libraries
```{r message=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

```

load data set
```{r}
data("instacart")

instacart = instacart |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

```

# What is the distribution of orders by hour of the day for each day of the week

```{r}
instacart |> 
  distinct(order_id, order_dow, order_hour_of_day) |> 
  count(order_dow, order_hour_of_day) |> 
  mutate(order_dow = factor(order_dow)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~order_hour_of_day, y = ~n, color = ~order_dow,
    type = "scatter", mode = "lines", colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Hour of the Day"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Orders"),
         legend = list(title = list(text ="Day of the Week")),
         title = "Instacart Orders by Hour For Each Day of the Week")
```


# What are the most reordered snacks?
```{r}

instacart |> 
  filter(department == "snacks") |> 
  group_by(product_name) |> 
  summarize(
    n_orders = n(),
    prop_reordered = mean(reordered)
  ) |> 
  filter(n_orders >= 500) |> 
  slice_max(prop_reordered, n = 10) |> 
  mutate(product_name = fct_reorder(product_name, prop_reordered)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~prop_reordered, y = ~product_name, color = ~product_name,
          type = "bar", orientation = "h", colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Proportion of orders that were reorders"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Snack Type"),
         title = "Most Reordered Snacks (among snacks ordered at least 500 times on Instacart)",
         showlegend = FALSE)
```

# Does order size differ by amount of days since last order?

```{r}

set.seed(1)

instacart |> 
  group_by(order_id, days_since_prior_order) |> 
  summarize(n_items = n(), .groups = "drop") |> 
  drop_na(days_since_prior_order) |> 
  sample_n(10000) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~days_since_prior_order, y = ~n_items, type = "box",
          mode = "markers", alpha = .5, colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(xaxis = list(title = "Days Since Prior Order (Capped at 30)"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Items in Order"),
         title = "Order Size vs. Number of Days Since Prior Order <br><sup>Random sample of 10,000 orders</sup>")
```
